If the backend cannot represent total contact resistance, the result explicitly blocks that requirement and labels any ideal-contact solve as a separate noncompliant comparison.
The numerical model applies total 18 W uniformly to the complete X=120 mm face, uses a 35 °C external rail reference, and insulates all longitudinal faces.
